author: Dataverse plugin base
name: Dataverse plugin assembly
description: A plugin assembly project that registers itself with the dv tooling. Create it inside a solution folder (CRM/Plugins/<Solution>/) - that placement is what decides which PowerApps solution it packs into. No config file needs editing.

isolationMode.description: Isolation mode the assembly is registered with.

pkgVersion.description: Version of Dataverse.Plugins.Abstractions to reference. Ignored inside the base repo, which imports the sources by path instead. Defaults to '*'; pin it once you have a real feed.
